scope: This file is the FROZEN SPEC of the rule: what the policy does, invariantly, for every protein, stratum, re-entry coordinate and schedule band. It deliberately carries no stratum_key, no B(r) values or digest, no protein id and no r_step -- those are per-cell RUN configuration and live in the resolved config and the band artifact. Keeping them out is what lets the four Canary cells share one signed projection_policy_spec while still pinning different reopen cardinalities.

identity_contract.policy_spec_digest: SHA-256 of THIS file. Invariant across cells; it is what conditioning.projection_policy_spec names and what the kernel matches the answering policy against.
identity_contract.policy_config_digest: Canonical digest of the per-cell realized binding (stratum_key + band calibration id/digest). Varies by cell BY DESIGN: two runs under different calibrations pinned different reopen cardinalities, so they ran the same rule under different configuration.
identity_contract.separation_rationale: Collapsing the two made the spec digest cell-specific, so no single frozen file could sign a multi-cell campaign, and it compared a canonical dict digest against a file sha256 -- two values that can never be equal.

state_partition.domain: the SOURCE partial state's editable positions only; hard anchors are never in any class
state_partition.totality: every editable position lands in exactly one class

rules.rule: the single lowest-indexed SOURCE-MASKED editable position
rules.rationale: the endpoint enters through one masked site. Writing over a RESOLVED position would change the 'a' term of the coupled identity and move the admissible reopen envelope -- a different experiment under this one's name.

rules.rule: previously-resolved editable positions taken LATEST-COMMITTED first, ties broken by ascending position index
rules.cardinality: read from admissible_reopen_cardinality(B(r_d)); NOT a free parameter
rules.rationale: the most recently committed identities carry the most future information relative to r_d, and taking from that end preserves the older carry_from_source class -- the only class a fixed-support ablation (PLAN §2.6 intervention 2) can target.

rules.rule: resolved editable positions not selected for reopen whose active commit step is >= r_d
rules.rationale: an identity committed at or after the re-entry boundary is future information there; it may not be represented as ordinary source carry (PLAN §2.4 rollback causality).

rules.rule: every remaining editable position: source-masked positions other than the write site, plus resolved positions not reopened whose active commit step is < r_d
rules.reason: inherited_mask when the source token is the mask token, otherwise temporally_valid

reopen_cardinality_law.a: endpoint writes landing on source-masked positions
reopen_cardinality_law.source: the run's declared schedule_band_calibration, looked up exactly by (r_d, stratum_key); lookup_band never interpolates
reopen_cardinality_law.note: the numeric envelope is per-cell and lives in the band artifact, never here

null_law.kind: typed PolicyRejection, never an exception and never a quiet fallback
conditions: no source-masked write site at r_d (every editable position already resolved)
B(r_d) is missing for this stratum, or the band intersection is empty
B(r_d) admits no feasible reopen cardinality here
null_law.rationale: a quiet fallback -- writing over a resolved position, or reopening fewer than the band demands -- would produce a transition under a partition nobody declared while the artifact named the declared one.

excluded_by_construction: schedule band quantiles or calibration digest
any Head, structure or reward evidence
not_authorized: This is the DIAGNOSTIC kernel probe. It is not the production FeedbackSupportPolicySpec of PLAN §2.5, which must additionally freeze residue-level Head-burden attribution, source-instability evidence, endpoint-sibling consensus and a matched source-off comparator. Registering this id does not authorize D>1.
